name: actual-cli
description: Checks your coding agent's plans before approval and its changes at the end of every turn against the ADR rules committed in .actual/rules/, briefs it on the rules for each file it reads, and lets you override a denied rule from the session. Also runs and troubleshoots the actual CLI, including adr-bot and the advisor on request

maxSessionChars.title: Rule brief: per-session character budget
maxSessionChars.description: Stop briefing once this many characters of rule context have been injected in one session. Measured: 40 governed files against a 425-rule repository injected 18,751 characters with dedup active, so the default is about 2.5x an ordinary session and exists to catch runaway accumulation, not to tune relevance. Set 0 to turn briefing off entirely where the mod loads; the Read hook used on older Claude Code has no cap.

maxChars.title: Rule brief: maximum characters per brief
maxChars.description: Passed to `actual rules brief --max-chars`. Rules are dropped whole, lowest-ranked first. Unset uses the CLI default (4000).

limit.title: Rule brief: decisions per brief
limit.description: Passed to `actual rules brief --limit`. Unset uses the CLI default (2).

rulesPerDecision.title: Rule brief: rules per decision
rulesPerDecision.description: Passed to `actual rules brief --rules-per-decision`. Unset uses the CLI default (8).

minScore.title: Rule brief: minimum rule score
minScore.description: Passed to `actual rules brief --min-score`. A per-repo tuning knob: scores measure how narrowly a rule's verify glob is written, so the useful value differs per repository. Unset defers to the repo's own `rules_min_score` config.

debug.title: Rule brief: log the budget each call
debug.description: Write a dim transcript line with the characters injected so far and the session's context usage, and add the same line to the model's context. Like ACTUAL_HOOK_DEBUG=1, which it is ORed with, but it does not turn on the not-briefed notes that variable adds.

overrideDialog.title: Governance: ask how to handle a denial
overrideDialog.description: When plan-check or impl-check denies, ask in a dialog whether to revise or override the blocking rules. Turn off to let the agent revise on its own without asking; /actual-cli:override still works. ACTUAL_OVERRIDE_DIALOG=off or =on wins over this setting.
